parameters.query:
-- Only articles we do not have yet and that are recent enough to be used, so
-- a check reads a handful of pages instead of every item in every feed. The
-- ingest API would catch a duplicate anyway, but only after we had fetched it.
SELECT x.*
  FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS x(url text, title text,
       published_at timestamptz, excerpt text, text text, publisher text)
 WHERE x.url IS NOT NULL
   AND x.title IS NOT NULL
   AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM items i
                    WHERE i.canonical_url = canonicalise_url(x.url))
   AND coalesce(x.published_at, now()) >= now() - make_interval(days =>
         (SELECT value::int FROM app_settings WHERE key = 'filter_max_age_days'))
 ORDER BY x.published_at DESC NULLS LAST
 LIMIT 20;
